name: Bug report
about: Report something that is broken or behaving incorrectly
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: ''

---

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## To reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behaviour:

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Expected behaviour

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Screenshots / recordings

If applicable, add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain the problem. **For accessibility bugs, a screen-reader transcript or screen recording is more useful than a screenshot.**

## Environment

- DescribeAT version / commit SHA: [e.g. v0.2.0 or commit `abc1234`]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 124, Safari 17.4, Firefox 125]
- OS: [e.g. iOS 17, Android 14, Windows 11, macOS 14, Ubuntu 22.04]
- Screen reader (if applicable): [e.g. NVDA 2024.1, JAWS 2024, VoiceOver iOS 17, TalkBack 14]
- Are you self-hosting or running against a mock backend?
- Were there any errors in the browser console or terminal?

## Accessibility-specific

If this bug affects accessibility (screen-reader announces wrong, focus order broken, contrast too low, keyboard trap, prefers-reduced-motion not respected, etc.):

- [ ] This is an accessibility bug — please add the `a11y` label
- Which assistive technology were you using?
- What did you expect the screen reader to announce?
- What did it actually announce?

## Additional context

Add any other context about the problem here — links, related issues, workarounds you've found.
